column1: # Operator ids that Flink generated for the outbox job at commit 0681d821, where
# only outbox-profile-lookup had a uid. A savepoint of that job keeps its state
# under these ids. The ids depend on which flows the job ran, ENABLE_OUTBOX and
# ENABLE_TIMER, so each shape has its own rows. They hold only for a job that ran
# at parallelism 2 or more. At parallelism 1 the timer flow chains differently,
# and the ids of watch-timers and watch-timeout-sink change.
